paper_title: Do direct detection experiments constrain axionlike particles coupled to electrons?
notes: This is a theoretical analysis paper that reinterprets existing experimental limits from GERDA, XENON1T, XMASS, LUX, PandaX-II, Majorana, SuperCDMS, and EDELWEISS-III. The paper does not report new experimental measurements from the authors. Instead, it shows that radiative ALP decay (a→γγ) makes many published dark matter limits self-inconsistent in the keV-MeV mass range. Figure 2 displays constraints from X-ray/gamma-ray astronomy (NuStar, XMM-Newton, INTEGRAL), but these are indirect constraints cited from other works, not new direct detection results from this paper.
